description:
Create an interactive GeoGebra visualization of the 2024 US federal income tax brackets (single filer). A reference file with the tax data is available at ~/Documents/GeoGebra/data/tax_brackets_2024.txt. 

You must:
1. Create a piecewise cumulative tax function T(x) using nested If() commands that calculates the total tax for income x. The function must cover at least the first 6 brackets (up to $609,350).
2. Create a step function m(x) showing the marginal tax rate (10%, 12%, 22%, etc.) for income x.
3. Add a slider for income (ranging from 0 to at least 250,000) to make the visualization interactive.
4. Add a dynamic text annotation showing the tax or rate values.
5. Adjust the axes so the graph is visible (x-axis up to at least $250,000, y-axis up to at least $60,000).

Save your project as 'tax_brackets.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/.
